away.summary: The Blackhawks (7-14-2) are projected to start Drew Commesso in goal, his first start since being recalled from Rockford on Nov. 8. The team is without Connor Bedard, Anton Frondell, and Bowen Byram due to injury, while Jordan Greenway and Wyatt Kaiser are listed as scratched. Toninato was recalled from Rockford, and Korchinski is likely to replace Kaiser, who has a Department of Player Safety hearing following a match penalty in Saturday's game.

home.summary: The Canucks (6-18-1) are projected to start Nikita Tolopilo in goal. The team is missing Elias Pettersson, Brendan Gallagher, Thatcher Demko, and Guillaume Brisebois due to injury, with Pettersson listed as day to day. Cameron Crotty and Kevin Lankinen are scratched, and Crotty could replace Luke Schenn in the lineup.
